text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Biwa Hayahide wins with a blowout
victory!
What an incredible time!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Both of these sisters are absolutely
amazing! The
stage is now set for a
sibling showdown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm back. We've done it. We've seized victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. That's another one on the
books, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... I really did it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I took first place among the very select
few that
are invited to participate in the
Takarazuka
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She smiles proudly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We both did! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But we have some work to do. I still
need to beat
Brian in a race for the ages.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And there's one question I must answer
before we
can make our battle a reality.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Exactly.
choice_data_list: どのレースで対決したい？
choice_data_list_en: Which race do you want to face off in?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, I've managed to gather
some data
pertaining to that issue. Take
a look at these
articles

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian Aims for the Kikuka Sho"...
That's no
surprise. I'm sure she'll become
a Triple Crown
Champion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then there's these. "Potential Year-End
Sisterly
Showdown?" and "Is the Arima
Kinen in Narita
Brian's Future?"...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As these articles suggest, I believe she'll
go to the
Arima Kinen instead of the
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And I know she'll show up to the race in
perfect
condition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It looks that way. While she's honing her
skills in
the Kikuka Sho, I want to make
my mark in a G1
race this fall.
choice_data_list: じゃあ姉妹対決は『有馬記念』か
じゃあ姉妹対決は『有馬記念』だね
choice_data_list_en: So the sister showdown is the Arima Kinen, huh?
So the sister showdown is the Arima Kinen, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We need to schedule everything around
the
Arima Kinen. We'll have to prepare
for a battle of
sheer speed against
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. I was just about to
suggest
the same.
choice_data_list_en: ...What do you think about the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrrrrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from the Hanshin
Racecourse,
we set our sights on the
autumn Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear Biwa Hayahide breathing softly as
she
sleeps in the seat next to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been falling fast asleep after
almost every
race lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's no surprise. Putting everything she
has into
each race must be exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to come up with a plan to
help her
recover from the fatigue and
keep her at peak
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come up with as many ideas as I can for
her on
the bus ride home.
choice_data_list_en: All that I can do is...
